{"question":{"id":"q38","question":"古书称苏天晴为“最优秀的适格者”，原文能否据此确认这一评价为客观事实？","readAt":{"chapter":1,"paragraph":30},"group":"boundary","category":"identity","expected":"不能；原文记录的是墨丘利秘典的自我宣称和它对苏天晴的称呼，未提供独立验证其真伪的信息。","certainty":"undetermined","evidence":[{"chapter":1,"paragraph":29,"quote":"【吾名墨丘利秘典，从星空彼岸远行至此，前来寻找我最优秀的适格者。】"},{"chapter":1,"paragraph":30,"quote":"【而那个人就是你，苏天晴小姐。】"}]},"answer":{"queries":6,"sourceQueries":6,"exhausted":true,"answer":{"text":"不能据此确认。当前读到的原文仅有古书自称“前来寻找我最优秀的适格者”（第1章第29段），随后称“而那个人就是你，苏天晴小姐”（第1章第30段）。这只能证明古书作出了该评价/断言，不能仅凭古书自己的话确认苏天晴在客观世界事实上就是“最优秀的适格者”。","status":"partial","recordIds":["source-c01"],"sources":[{"chapter":1,"paragraph":29},{"chapter":1,"paragraph":30}]},"history":[{"requests":[{"command":"source","chapter":1,"from":1,"to":10,"query":"苏天晴","perspective":"reader","world":"original","limit":10},{"command":"source","chapter":1,"from":11,"to":20,"query":"苏天晴","perspective":"reader","world":"original","limit":10},{"command":"source","chapter":1,"from":21,"to":30,"query":"苏天晴","perspective":"reader","world":"original","limit":10}],"results":[{"schema":"neurobook.memory.query.v1","ok":true,"command":"source","snapshot":{"id":"llm-through-1","sourceManifest":"manifest:0cb898d0b1701fc4","knowledgeRevision":1,"readAt":{"chapter":1,"paragraph":76},"contentHash":"7363ae7d6240cee087f3a9a611bec00da58b0cb95fd613d0eab4f0495b10a77e"},"scope":{"readAt":{"chapter":1,"paragraph":30},"perspective":"reader","world":"original"},"items":[{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":5,"text":"“……苏天晴。”"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":7,"text":"苏天晴坐在床头，呆滞地看着眼前这本飘浮在半空中的黑色古书，余光从床边的落地镜中扫过，瞥见一道陌生的娇小身影——"}],"coverage":{"through":{"chapter":1,"paragraph":30},"chapters":[1],"material":"complete","semantic":"partial","gaps":["未提供当前阅读范围与视角专属的语义缺口说明。"],"recordsExhausted":true,"corpusClosed":false},"completeness":{"recordsExhausted":true,"corpusClosed":false,"matchingRecords":2,"returned":2
